issues.description: Stroke weight is slightly heavier in the render than in the original. The vertical segments AD, EF and HG and the base BC look a little thicker than the original's hairlines.

issues.suggestion: Optionally wrap labels in $...$ or use \mathit to match the italic typeface; this is cosmetic only.
